description: Send the human owner a claim invite for the agent-registered OpenTrain account. Ask the human for their email first. OpenTrain emails them a verification link and code; once they accept, they own the account and can add billing. Follow up with opentrain_claim_status to check whether the claim completed.

claimToken.description: Claim token from opentrain_register_agent. Defaults to the token saved in the shared OpenTrain config.

email.description: The human owner's email address. OpenTrain emails them a claim invite so they can take over the account and add billing.

name: opentrain_claim_account
